## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo build --release`, `cargo test --release` and `cargo clippy --release --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.
- [ ] `docs/progress` is not part of the change (it is regenerated after merging).
- [ ] No GPL code (yuzu, suyu, ScarletNX and derivatives), leaked or NDA material.
- [ ] No game data: binaries, extracted shaders, textures, screenshots, memory dumps, keys or firmware.
- [ ] Code taken from MIT/BSD projects keeps its original copyright notice (see [LEGAL.md](../LEGAL.md)).
- [ ] Commit messages start with `feat:`, `fix:` or `chore:`.
